name: @taraborrelli/api-client
description: Typed client for the Taraborrelli backend, with types generated from each service's OpenAPI.

scripts.generate: sh scripts/export-openapi.sh && openapi-typescript openapi/auth.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/generated/auth.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/lead.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/generated/lead.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/property.json --default-non-nullable false -o src/generated/property.ts && prettier --write src/generated
